method: Actual component/effect functions with manual React hook storage, deferred promises and controlled timer callbacks; static markup. No browser scheduler/runtime/status persistence proof.

controls.name: LOADING makes at most twelve serial ID-only reads at five-second intervals
an unresolved read blocks overlap and the status button until it settles
READY and refusal states stop polling after LOADING
transport error clears old status, stops polls and explicit check restarts
unmount clears a pending timer without another read
unmount ignores late successful and failed in-flight responses
request/API change ignores the old late response and retains new issued ID
explicit check cancels waiting timer and resets a bounded twelve-read cycle
missing reader and empty issued ID make no status request or timer
